app.VGlrYQ.desc.source:
Detect content types and extract text from documents using [Apache Tika](https://tika.apache.org/).

**Capabilities**:
- Extract text content from HTML, XML, plain text, and other formats
- Detect MIME content types automatically
- Extract document metadata (author, title, creation date, etc.)

Additional format support (PDF, Office, images) can be enabled by adding Tika parser module JARs to the Java classpath.
app.VGlrYQ.desc.message:

app.VGlrYQ.action.ZXh0cmFjdA.short_desc.source: Extract text content and metadata from a file
app.VGlrYQ.action.ZXh0cmFjdA.short_desc.message: Extract text content and metadata from a file

app.VGlrYQ.action.ZXh0cmFjdA.desc.source:
Extracts text content, metadata, and MIME type from a file at a specific file location using Apache Tika.

Returns a single record containing:
- `content` — the extracted text content
- `content_type` — the detected MIME type
- `metadata` — a hash of extracted metadata (author, title, dates, etc.)
- `content_length` — the length of the extracted text content

Tika automatically detects the file format and applies the appropriate parser.

app.VGlrYQ.action.ZXh0cmFjdC1kYXRh.short.source: Extract text content and metadata from inline binary data
app.VGlrYQ.action.ZXh0cmFjdC1kYXRh.short.message: Extract text content and metadata from inline binary data

app.VGlrYQ.action.ZXh0cmFjdC1kYXRh.desc.source:
Extracts text content, metadata, and MIME type from inline binary data using Apache Tika.

Returns a single record containing:
- `content` — the extracted text content
- `content_type` — the detected MIME type
- `metadata` — a hash of extracted metadata (author, title, dates, etc.)
- `content_length` — the length of the extracted text content

Use this action when the file content is already available in memory as binary data.

app.VGlrYQ.action.ZGV0ZWN0.short_desc.source: Detect the MIME type of a file without full content extraction
app.VGlrYQ.action.ZGV0ZWN0.short_desc.message: Detect the MIME type of a file without full content extraction

app.VGlrYQ.action.ZGV0ZWN0.desc.source:
Detects the MIME type of a file at a specific file location using Apache Tika without performing full content extraction.

Returns a single record containing:
- `content_type` — the detected MIME type
- `metadata` — a hash of extracted metadata

This is faster than full extraction when only the MIME type is needed.
